column3: Manages appointment creation, scheduling, and rebooking.
Manages patient demographic/admin data (contact, insurance, etc).
Validates and approves medical prescriptions before delivery.
Writes and edits medical notes, diagnoses, and evolution entries.
Read-only access to medical records (auditors, assistants).
Handles invoices, payments, refunds, and insurance claims.
Creates and manages internal users (staff, doctors).
Views access logs, digital signatures, IPFS hashes, blockchain records.
View own medical history, labs, prescriptions.
Sign or revoke digital consent forms.
View when and who accessed their records.
Edit own contact info, address, insurance.
Assign access to trusted third parties (e.g. caregivers).
View blockchain proof of their medical events.
Unrestricted access to all system operations, including platform-level management, user control, security, and audit logs.
